newsitem.title: UK: UK's CDC appoints business development director.
newsitem.headline: UK's CDC appoints business development director.

text.p: The Commonwealth Development Corporation (CDC), the UK's overseas development finance institution, has appointed Paul Jobson director of the Business Development Department from January 1997.
Jobson joins from Equity Capital for Industry, the venture capital firm now owned by N M Rothschild, where he is currently a partner and director.
Previously he was at Massey Ferguson, where he was involved in the company refinancing, and at the Varity Corporation.

A statement from CDC said it had restructured the business development department. Jobson will be responsible for deal structuring and due diligence, while four specialists have been appointed internally to manage key sectors.
These are Jim Romanos for Infrastructure, Geoff Tylert for Agribusiness, Nick Sabin for Manufacturing and Commerce and John Hodder for Minerals, Oil and Gas.
CDC operates in 50 countries worldwide and at end-1995 had investments totalling 1.5 billion in 369 businesses.
